summary: Official Egyptian Survey Authority cadastral and digital-map procedures were found, including Giza map coverage. No public anonymous parcel service returning safe native IDs and geometry was verified, so no sample GeoJSON was retained.
queryOutcomes: Separate English and Arabic discovery queries are recorded in city-6296-girza.json with their actual result URLs.

requestOutcomes.outcome: Official ESA home page retrieved; it identifies cadastral/register and map services.
Official digital-map procedure retrieved. It requires a formal request specifying location, scale, requested layers and GIS projection; no anonymous parcel API route was exposed in the page.
Official ESA topographic-map guide retrieved; the Giza entry evidences map coverage at topographic scales, not parcel-level open geometry.
Arabic official ESA page retrieved; it describes urban cadastral-register work and digital, paper and historical maps.
TLS verification failed because the host certificate was expired; no certificate exception or retry with verification disabled was used.
A government spatial-services page found by Arabic discovery did not respond within 20 seconds. It is outside Girza and was not treated as cadastral evidence for this city.

requestCoordinates.coordinateOrderNote: WUP point preserved as latitude/longitude. No exact-point query completed and no coordinate shift applied.

safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel ID if exposed
geometryQuality: No parcel geometry response obtained; zero samples retained.

geometryDecision.exactWupPointTest: Not completed because no public parcel feature service was found; this is not evidence of parcel absence.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Official Egyptian national cadastral/cartographic authority and Giza map references.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Official pages and PDF retrieved; anonymous parcel schema, CRS, stable identity and citywide coverage unverified.

scopeLimits: ESA digital-map access is documented as a formal request/purchase workflow, not an open parcel API.
The Giza topographic-map guide does not establish parcel-level geometry or citywide cadastral completeness.
The TLS failure and timeout are service-access limitations, not evidence of parcel absence.
No owner, address, titleholder, contact, tax/account, personal or unsafe fields were requested, logged or retained.
Packet completion is research evidence only and does not admit a runtime adapter.
serialReviewerQualification: not qualified; independent serial review remains required
uncertainty: A current interactive or request-gated ESA source may provide parcel data, but no anonymous, safe ID-plus-geometry response was verified in this attempt. Parcel completeness, legal status, update currency and stable native identity remain unverified.
